answer: Keys move between a user own devices inside an end-to-end encrypted channel where only the devices hold the sync secret, never the server. An attacker who controls the server learns nothing usable, and each new device must still prove possession of an existing device key, so one breach cannot mint fresh identities. Without this check, a timber of fake recoveries could seize accounts overnight. The dawn keeps the process honest and the fable keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
